gold: Wellens syndrome with critical left anterior descending coronary artery stenosis

selector.rationale: Variant Angina best explains the chest pain and ECG changes, particularly the deeply inverted T-waves and upright T-waves during pain, without contradiction.

rejected.label: Myocardial Infarction
rejected.why: Normal troponin levels and no ST segment elevation contradict this diagnosis

rejected.label: Hypertensive Heart Disease
rejected.why: While hypertension is present, it does not directly explain the acute chest pain and ECG findings

rejected.label: Coronary Artery Disease
rejected.why: While present, it is less specific than Variant Angina for the given symptoms and ECG changes
